title: Predictive correlates of response to the anti-PD-L1 antibody MPDL3280A in cancer patients

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Predictive correlates of response to the anti-PD-L1 antibody MPDL3280A in cancer patients》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】The development of human cancer is a multistep process characterized by the accumulation of genetic and epigenetic alterations that drive or reflect tumour progression.

evidence.text: The development of human cancer is a multistep process characterized by the accumulation of genetic and epigenetic alterations that drive or reflect tumour progression.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Predictive correlates of response to the anti-PD-L1 antibody MPDL3280A in cancer patients》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-9】Here we show that across multiple cancer types, responses (as evaluated by Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumours, version 1.1) were observed in patients with tumours expressing high levels of PD-L1, especially when PD-L1 was expressed by tumour-infiltrating immune cells.

【Abstract · abstract-1-11】Together, these data suggest that MPDL3280A is most effective in patients in which pre-existing immunity is suppressed by PD-L1, and is re-invigorated on antibody treatment.

evidence.text: Here we show that across multiple cancer types, responses (as evaluated by Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumours, version 1.1) were observed in patients with tumours expressing high levels of PD-L1, especially when PD-L1 was expressed by tumour-infiltrating immune cells.
Together, these data suggest that MPDL3280A is most effective in patients in which pre-existing immunity is suppressed by PD-L1, and is re-invigorated on antibody treatment.
